QuestInfo.name: Making a Bigger Saddle
QuestInfo.0: Ask #b#p2060005##k in #b#m230000000##k to make you a bigger saddle.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2060005# says he will make you a saddle that is flexible enough for #p1013000#. However, the materials are going to be quite a challenge.

A #b#t4032476##k from Shipwreck Treasure Chests in Ocean I.C., Crystal Gorge , Red Coral Forest, or Turban Shell Hill, and some #b#t4032477##k, a specialty product of #m251000000#, from Captain Hwang.
QuestInfo.2: After receiving all the materials, #p2060005# made you the #t1912034#. With this, you should be able to mount comfortably for awhile.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
Can proceed to either quest, #q80001317# #s80001317# 'Acquisition' or 
'Uncomfortable Saddle II'

0.0: Hello. Aren't you the person who special ordered a saddle before. What brings you back? Whoa, that animal next to you, is that the same animal as before? It's huge now! I can hardly recognize it!
0.1: Seeing that animal, I can guess why you are here. He's gotten so big, there's no way that saddle still fits him. Are you here to order a #bnew saddle#k?

yes.0: Okay, I will make another special saddle for you. Seeing how much it has grown, I'll have to use a more flexible material this time. Hmm... The only materials that might work are so expensive, I'm not sure if you'll be able to find them...
yes.1:
Let me tell you what the materials are. First, #b2 #t4032476#s#k. They can be obtained from #bShipwreck Treasure Chest#k on the wrecked ship deep inside Aqua Road. 
\nBy the way, the Shipwreck Treasure Chest looks like this.\n#i4032557#
yes.2: Second, you need #b2#k pieces of #b#t4032477##k, which are a rarity in #m251000000#. It used to be sold in #m251000000#, but for some reason it isn't sold anymore. You'll have to ask #b#p2092001##k about that...
yes.3: Third, and most important, you need to pay a fee of #b30 million Mesos#k.
yes.4: What? I'm the only person in Maple World who can handle those kinds of materials. Besides, you must be rich to have such an interesting animal.
yes.5: What?! I'm the only person in Maple World that can handle those kinds of materials. Besides, you must be rich to have such an interesting animal.

no.0: I guess you don't need a saddle? By the looks of it though, I doubt that the old saddle is going to fit anymore...

1.0: You brought all the materials! I'll start making your saddle right away.

yes.0: A beautiful saddle has been completed that is flexible enough to let the animal move yet strong enough to protect the rider.
yes.1: However, there is a limit to the flexibility of this saddle. I'm not sure how big this Dragon will get, but if it gets too big, the saddle might not be able to handle it. If that happens, you'll have to come back and order a new one.

item.0: Did you forget what the materials were? #b2 #t4032476#s#k, which can be obtained from Aqua Road Ocean I.C, Crystal Gorge, Red Coral Forest, or Turban Shell Hill. And, #b#m251000000#'s specialty#k, #b2 pieces of #t4032477##k.
item.1: I will make you the saddle if you bring me all those materials along with a fee of #b30 million mesos#k.
